Fin (formerly Intercom) and Freshworks (4/5), and Meta's free Business Agent (3/5) also qualify leads. Still open: email as a full channel in an SMB inbox; a business-defined match score with priority sorting as the core screen; a native sales CRM at SMB prices, India-first. Agents A (Kinso AI) and B (HighLevel etc.) were stopped and are not counted yet.
